description: Inspect FlowState's sessions. They open and close by themselves (closed after 2 hours idle or when the app quits, with a summary queued for review), so this is rarely needed. current, list, conversations: read. start: returns the automatic session. end: close one with a summary (not undoable). Decisions go in log_work. Returns session or conversation rows.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

focus_component_id.description: start: component in focus (ignored if a session is open).

focus_problem_id.description: start: problem in focus (ignored if a session is open).

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

project.description: Project name or id. Required except for current.

session_id.description: end: the session's id (required). conversations: only this session.

name: manage_sessions
